objective: Build and audit a source-record-disjoint English-core teacher-query expansion that directly addresses the V101 conditional structural coverage deficit without changing model architecture or using held-out development text to synthesize answers.

rationale.measured_limiting_factor: V101 measured target fourgram coverage below 95% in every capability, with the largest gaps in instruction following, abstention, clarification, conversation, fact-free reasoning, and tone control.
rationale.authorized_change: Increase source-context and conditional surface diversity using a revision-pinned local TinyStories cache as fictional supplied context for the same frozen teacher.
prohibited_changes: No V94 topology or loss-weight changes
No retraining on the unchanged original 7000 records
No teacher generation in this catalog-build gate

catalog_design.selection_policy: Fixed minhash selection from the pinned train corpus for search and the pinned validation corpus for disjoint validation/final contexts.
catalog_design.development_leakage_control: Capability-level V101 aggregate deficits motivated balanced expansion, but no held-out development prompt, response, exact ngram, or record is used to construct or select a search story.

source_corpus.license_boundary: Use is restricted to local research evidence because the cached dataset metadata does not establish a distributable derived-data license.

decision_rule: Only a passing immutable catalog audit can authorize a separately preregistered teacher-extraction successor. Catalog PASS is not Phase 3 certification.
claim_boundary: No-model catalog construction protocol only. It does not establish teacher response quality, acquisition sufficiency, LayerCake fluency, or Phase 3 certification.
